data.gender_notes: Sharveshkar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharveshkar is a compound name, where 'Sharva' means God and 'Ishwar' means Lord. Thus, Sharveshkar means the 'God of Wisdom'. The name Sharveshkar carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sharveshkar usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name is ideal for those seeking spiritual growth and wisdom, and those who wish to lead a life guided by the divine.
data.etymology: Sharveshkar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharveshkar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
